comparison.objective: Start and tighten a bracket bolt with a ratchet in confined access; candidate replaces a confined harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Thread starting and short-stroke ratcheting versus latch release, extraction, keyed alignment, mating, and cable handling.
comparison.success_condition: PR proposes thread capture, seating, torque, tool return, and release, though its live scorer is unqualified; candidate lacks any executable connector rubric.
comparison.reason: Confined access is shared, but the central tested mechanics—threaded fastening versus connector mating—are meaningfully different.
